xgboost.name: XGBoost (Gradient Boosted Trees)
xgboost.description: GPU histogram boosting with calibration + ECE, cost-adjusted PnL simulation, SHAP feature attribution.

transformer_2s.name: Two-Stream Transformer (Price + Volume)
transformer_2s.description: Two-stream attention encoder over OHLCV. Price stream Linear(4->112) + sinusoidal PE; volume stream Linear(1->16) no PE; concat to d=128, TransformerEncoder.

transformer_tiny.name: Tiny Transformer (Single-Stream)
transformer_tiny.description: ~10-20k param single-stream Transformer for low-data regimes (e.g. daily MNQ with ~2k bars). Walk-forward folds + 2-bar purge.

primitives_cnn.name: CNN+Transformer (Primitives Discovery)
primitives_cnn.description: Feature-Attention CNN+Transformer over ~510 mathematical primitives. Three output heads: direction, magnitude, confidence.

temporal_fusion_transformer.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer
temporal_fusion_transformer.description: Interpretable TFT (Lim et al. 2019) adapted for single-shot classification over rolling feature windows: per-timestep variable selection, GRN gating, LSTM local encoder, interpretable multi-head attention. Ships verbose diagnostics + filter-normalized loss surface. GENERATE family â€” Jinja2 template temporal_fusion_transformer.py.j2.

online_rls_mtf.name: Online RLS (Sliding Multi-Timeframe)
online_rls_mtf.description: Recursive Least Squares updated on every closed candle, over a ladder of SLIDING windows (a rolling 233-bar mean is the 233-minute view, phase-free, unlike a resampled bar whose values depend on where you anchored it). Generalises Corsi HAR from three scales to any ladder. Exact at lambda=1.0 -- coefficients equal batch OLS -- so there is no learning rate to tune. Attribution is closed-form: phi_i = w_i(x_i - E[x_i]).
